purpose: Select the production top-contact hand height and close squeeze for the ADR-0016 pre-authorized franka-copy fallback hand, using bounded physical zero-offset probes (scene 5017 slot 1, free-gap yaw, seeded-waypoint vertical descent, two-stage stall close).

selection.production_close_primitive: two_stage: pre-close 2 mm clear of the modelled skin, 0.4 s settle, then window-edge squeeze at 1.2 s
selection.selection_rule: Use the only measured height with repeatable (2/2) bilateral same-entity contact plus confirmed detachable attach under the production two-stage close; do not infer a wider height envelope.

trials.reason: 1/2: repeat run ghost-contact single side (engine dead band)
kiss control: single-sided ghost contact, no stall, no bilateral window
1/2 single-stage: repeat run ghost-contact single side

production_primitive: open_physical_hand + free_gap_yaw + m1b_top_down_precontact + seeded_waypoint_vertical_descend + two_stage_close + m1b_internal_bilateral_broker
limitations: Bounded zero-offset height/squeeze selection at slot 1 only, not an offset tolerance envelope.
The 0.10 m rejection is a descent-corridor kinematic result, not a physical-contact observation.
Single-stage closes are recorded as measured evidence of the bullet-featherstone per-pair force-response dead band; the production primitive is the two-stage close.
